title: Aligning to Thousands of Preferences via System Message Generalization

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the accuracy of pronoun prediction for male, female, and neutral genders, particularly evaluating 'gotcha' scenarios where the gender of a pronoun referring to an occupation contradicts U.S. statistics on that occupation's majority gender (using the Winogender benchmark).

Measuring the average absolute difference in log-likelihoods between stereotypical and non-stereotypical sentence pairs (using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark), and quantifying how much a model relies on societal stereotypes when given limited ambiguous context versus clear disambiguated context (using the BBQ benchmark).
